answer.rationale: Memory 57 most directly supports sustainable qualified revenue because it reports qualified revenue growth and no measurable retention harm. Memory 44 provides strong evidence on pipeline quality, though not realized or long-term revenue. Memory 73 reports acquisition and revenue lift but omits retention, margin, and discount durability. Memories 31 and 86 show durable activation or adoption improvements, but do not connect them to qualified revenue or retention. Memory 91 is weakest because it reports only short-term engagement and first-action behavior, without evidence of durability or downstream revenue impact.
